CommunityApplications.Profile: TypeBitTorrent is a BitTorrent client built on the TypeBit Rust engine. The container runs the head-less build of the same client that ships for Windows and Android, and serves its built-in WebUI: transfers (add magnet/.torrent, pause, resume, remove), per-file priorities and renames, tracker editing, live peer list, engine statistics, search, RSS and torrent creation. Downloads are written directly to the array. Report issues and feature requests on the project's GitHub issue tracker.
